messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: multiple regions showing surge in 5xx + latency for smart-routing service (route-engine) — alert id: RTE-2026-04-12-001

Aisha (sre-oncall): I got the page, I'm on it. brief status?

Liam (eng-runtime): Seeing repeated fallback churn between eu-west and us-east. Traffic flips every ~30s, kv cache thrash, lots of partial responses. Root cause looks policy-related.

Maya (prod-ops): Customers reporting partial completions, some LLM responses truncated — support queue spiking. Which policy changed recently?

Liam (eng-runtime): We deployed configschema v3.2.0 at 02:13 UTC. Validator stripped deprecated field `preferred_region` but we have a migration that was supposed to map it to `region_hint`. Looks like default mapping didn't run for some routes, so route-engine falls back to variant selection heuristic -> picks `latency-opt` variant that is only provisioned in us-east, causing mass cross-region failovers.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Can we toggle routing fallback to stable? Temporary mitigation: disable cross-region fallback and force `variant=stable` for critical customers. Who can patch the runtime flag?

Diego (platform): I can push a feature-flag change to kill cross-region fallback via the control plane. Need a one-line config: `routing.cross_region_fallback.enabled=false` — apply to prod global policy. Will do if SRE confirms.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Do it. Also open a capacity burst for stable variant in eu-west so we avoid queuing.

Diego (platform): Applying flag now (cmd pasted):
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/api/flags -d '{"key":"routing.cross_region_fallback.enabled","value":false,"scope":"global"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}'
```
Status: 202 accepted.

Liam (eng-runtime): Pushed hotfix to route-engine to prefer pinned variant when `variant` field present. Patch id: fe3a9b2. Rolling to edge/pop.

incident-bot: deploy-bot reports: fe3a9b2 deployed to canary (2 instances) at 02:41 UTC.

Marcus (sre-oncall-2): increasing stable variant pool in eu-west: autoscale override +50% for 15m.

Jon (support): On customer side, we have ~8 tickets flagged P1: streaming truncation, mainly customers in EU. Putting a short customer notification: "We're investigating intermittent truncation for some requests; mitigating now." Want me to send?

Aisha (sre-oncall): Yes, send that. Add that we expect reduction in errors in ~10-15m. Mark affected customers: enterprise-accounts with dedicated routes and high qps.

Priya (security): Any data exfil risk? This is routing, not auth, but confirm no requests were routed to third-party endpoints.

Liam (eng-runtime): No third-party routing. This is internal model variant selection only. No new access keys, nothing in audit logs beyond normal routing.

Maya (prod-ops): After applying flag and patch, latency on eu-west traces started improving. 5xx decreased from 12% -> 1.8% in last 5m.

incident-bot: alert RTE-2026-04-12-001 -> STATUS: partial_mitigated at 02:55 UTC (reduction in error rate).

Aisha (sre-oncall): Good. Next steps: 1) keep flag off until we confirm migration script fixes; 2) run a backfill to populate `region_hint` for any routes that had `preferred_region` set; 3) add validator check to fail schema deploys that drop deprecated-to-new mapping. Assign owners?

Liam (eng-runtime): I'll own backfill script + validator update. Plan: run a read over configstore for routes with legacy field, patch them to proper `region_hint` and `variant` if missing. Draft migration command: 
```
python tools/migrate_routes.py --from-field preferred_region --to-field region_hint --dry-run
```
I'll run dry-run then apply.

Diego (platform): I'll add a CI gate that prevents schema deploys unless migration report produced.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Support, prepare a post-incident customer note template. Ops, prepare capacity plan if load continues. Security stands by.

Jon (support): Draft note: "We experienced an internal routing policy regression that caused some requests to route to a less-provisioned model variant, causing higher errors and truncated streams for some EU customers. The issue is mitigated; a full postmortem will follow. If you see ongoing errors please DM us and include request ids."

Priya (security): We'll run a quick audit of routing access — ping me the migration PR.

Liam (eng-runtime): Dry-run migration shows ~120 routes with legacy `preferred_region` set. 95% map cleanly to `region_hint`; ~6 routes need manual review because they had conflicting variant overrides.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Manual review owners?

Maya (prod-ops): I'll help review the 6. Tagging Carlos from solutions? (not present) but we can handle.

incident-bot: pager-delta: alert suppression enabled for next 30m to avoid alert storms while we stabilize.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Marcus, I'm going to handoff monitoring/war room to you for the next 45m while I start the postmortem doc. Key things to track: error rate, latency p50/p95 for eu-west, cross-region egress bytes.

Marcus (sre-oncall-2): Taking over. Contact me for any blocker. I'll escalate if error rate >3% or latency p95 increases >200ms.

Diego (platform): CI gate PR opened: #7742 — enforces migration report artifact.

Liam (eng-runtime): Applied migration for the 120 routes at 03:18 UTC. No manual conflicts after minor tweaks.

incident-bot: automation: migration-run completed at 03:19 UTC. 120 routes updated.

Maya (prod-ops): Observability shows stable variant usage in eu-west back to normal. Error rate steady ~0.6%.

Jon (support): Sent customer note to impacted accounts at 03:25 UTC. Several replies acknowledging and asking for postmortem.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Closing the immediate pager: mitigated -> will keep monitoring under Marcus. Please attach logs/traces to postmortem. Liam, Diego, add remediation tickets for validator and CI gate.

Liam (eng-runtime): Remediation tickets created: RTE-ISSUE-431 (validator), RTE-ISSUE-432 (migration tests).

Priya (security): I reviewed access logs, nothing suspicious. Marking security review complete for now.

Marcus (sre-oncall-2): Monitoring handoff notes: continue to watch for any residual variant oscillation; if it returns, revert routing flag and route to safe-mode (explicit `variant=stable`).

Aisha (sre-oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem: I'll start the doc and tag owners. Lessons so far: deprecated-field migrations must be deterministic; validator should prevent silent drops; control-plane flags are useful but we need a runbook for quick safeswitch.

Maya (prod-ops): Also propose an emergency route-level override that support can apply for an individual customer while SRE remediates global policy.

Jon (support): Noted, will file UX request for in-console temporary overrides.

incident-bot: Incident RTE-2026-04-12-001 -> RESOLVED (mitigated, remediation in progress) at 03:30 UTC.

Aisha (sre-oncall): End of thread for now — will post postmortem link when available. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
